audience: HR and payroll teams with authorized Jisr Open API access

useCases.title: Review employee records
useCases.text: Find employees by status or joining dates, then read an authorized employee profile. Profiles can include sensitive identity and contact information.

useCases.title: Check attendance and leave
useCases.text: Review attendance summaries and annual leave balances for a selected period or group of employees.

useCases.title: Review payroll transactions
useCases.text: Read payroll transactions for a confirmed pay period using a key with the required financial permissions. This does not send salary payments.

useCases.title: Register a new employee
useCases.text: Create an employee record using lookup IDs. Jisr sends the employee an invitation email.

useCases.title: Import device attendance punches
useCases.text: Submit genuine device punches for asynchronous processing, then inspect the attendance logs. Submission does not guarantee every punch was accepted.
